Overview.Name: Endarapu Rajitha
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1: Option 1: Vegetable dosa (1) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & boiled egg (1)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (small portion) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Paneer stir fry (60 g) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & grilled chicken (small portion)

Notes_and_Tips: Since stress triggers overeating, serve one fixed plate and avoid eating directly from cooking vessels.
Rice and chapati are included to keep the plan realistic and easy to follow.
Sweet cravings can be managed by eating dal or paneer first before choosing sweets.
Keep lunch slightly stronger since it is your preferred meal for non-veg inclusion.
Simple home style cooking will help maintain steady energy and long term consistency.
